'''Lower Sundari Outpost''', originally known as '''Sundari Imperial Outpost''', was an outpost located on the south edge of the [[Sundari Flatlands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Built on the cliffs overlooking the [[Barasin Refuse Yards]], the outpost was reclaimed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Balmorran resistance]] sometime between [[3643 BBY]] and [[3642 BBY]].
